one_liner: Djokovic's grass_wr_career 0.9167 is the highest surface win rate of any player in this set.
three_things: Nearly surface-agnostic: career win rates of 0.9167 on grass, 0.8632 on hard, 0.8226 on clay.
Recent form holds up strongly: hard_wr_recent 0.8404 and clay_wr_recent 0.7872.
Small clay-vs-hard gap in both windows (clay_minus_hard_career -0.0406, clay_minus_hard_recent -0.0532).
context_note: Descriptive career and recent-form surface win rates as of the corpus end, not a prediction and not an edge claim. Per-surface floors apply (n>=30 career, independent floors for recent form); below-floor metrics show n/a, and nothing here adjusts for era, opponent quality, or draw.
